key: ADRIENN: Well, if it isn't my favorite Champion!
en: ADRIENN: Well, if it isn't my favorite Champion!
ja: アドリエンヌ: あら、お気に入りのチャンピオンじゃない!

key: Always a pleasure.
en: Always a pleasure.
ja: いつだってうれしいものね。

key: The view here is uniquely beautiful.
en: The view here is uniquely beautiful.
ja: ここの景色は、他にない美しさがあるわ。

key: I was just enjoying a rare moment of serenity.
en: I was just enjoying a rare moment of serenity.
ja: ちょうど、めったにない静けさのひとときを楽しんでいたところなの。

key: I'd come to do my part, helping to contain the Anomalies...
en: I'd come to do my part, helping to contain the Anomalies...
ja: アノマリーの封じ込めに、少しでも力になろうと思って来たのだけれど……

key: With everything required of me by managing the city, I haven't found the time I would've liked to be able to join you all.
en: With everything required of me by managing the city, I haven't found the time I would've liked to be able to join you all.
ja: 街の運営に追われて、みんなと一緒に行動する時間がなかなか取れなくてね。

key: This opportunity was welcome,
en: This opportunity was welcome,
ja: この機会はありがたかったのだけど、

key: But when I got here...
en: But when I got here...
ja: ここに来てみたら……

key: Well it's just as you see.
en: Well it's just as you see.
ja: まあ、見ての通りよ。

key: A shimmering pool of nearly-still starlight,
en: A shimmering pool of nearly-still starlight,
ja: ほとんど揺らめきもしない、きらめく星明かりの水たまり、

key: A few shadows stirring below the surface,
en: A few shadows stirring below the surface,
ja: 水面の下でわずかに揺れる影、

key: And not much else.
en: And not much else.
ja: それくらいで、他には何も。

key: Hardly anything that needs containing.
en: Hardly anything that needs containing.
ja: 封じ込めが必要なものなんて、ほとんどないわ。

key: Maybe something would appear here in the future,
en: Maybe something would appear here in the future,
ja: いつか何かが現れることもあるかもしれないけれど、

key: But for now, just this.
en: But for now, just this.
ja: 今のところは、これだけね。

key: A time to breathe.
en: A time to breathe.
ja: 一息つける時間。

key: I've had precious few of them lately.
en: I've had precious few of them lately.
ja: 最近は、そういう時間がほとんどなかったの。

key: I feel as if every time I blink, the world has left me behind all over again.
en: I feel as if every time I blink, the world has left me behind all over again.
ja: まばたきをするたびに、世界にまた置いていかれているような気がするわ。

key: So much is always happening, and I want to be there for it,
en: So much is always happening, and I want to be there for it,
ja: いつも色々なことが起きていて、その場にいたいと思っているのだけれど、

key: But I also crave these moments of stillness,
en: But I also crave these moments of stillness,
ja: こういう静けさの瞬間も、渇望してしまうの、

key: Like some part of me is still frozen in time.
en: Like some part of me is still frozen in time.
ja: まるで自分の一部が、まだ時間の中で凍りついているみたいに。

key: Some part of me still wants to be.
en: Some part of me still wants to be.
ja: あたしの一部は、まだそこにいたいと思っているのかもしれない。

key: At first I hated the idea that I'd lost so many years,
en: At first I hated the idea that I'd lost so many years,
ja: 最初は、あんなに多くの年月を失ったという考えが、憎らしくて仕方なかった、

key: And I still do, of course.
en: And I still do, of course.
ja: もちろん、今でもそう思っているけれど。

key: And yet...
en: And yet...
ja: それでも……

key: Perhaps I would do it again.
en: Perhaps I would do it again.
ja: きっと、もう一度同じことをするでしょうね。

key: To have the chance to step into the future, to make sure that the world is still on the right track...
en: To have the chance to step into the future, to make sure that the world is still on the right track...
ja: 未来へ一歩を踏み出し、世界がまだ正しい道を歩んでいることを確かめられるという、そのチャンスのためになら……

key: It's been an unforgettable, sublime experience, if a stressful one.
en: It's been an unforgettable, sublime experience, if a stressful one.
ja: ストレスの多い経験ではあったけれど、忘れがたい、崇高な体験だったわ。

key: I have all of these desires-- so much I want to do-- so many people I want to help.
en: I have all of these desires-- so much I want to do-- so many people I want to help.
ja: やりたいことも、助けたい人も、数えきれないくらいあるの。

key: If I could, I would sit down with every single person and listen to all their troubles.
en: If I could, I would sit down with every single person and listen to all their troubles.
ja: できることなら、一人一人と向き合って、それぞれの悩みに耳を傾けたい。

key: I would like to move the world for every person I meet.
en: I would like to move the world for every person I meet.
ja: 出会う人みんなのために、世界を動かしてあげたいの。

key: But I can't.
en: But I can't.
ja: でも、それはできない。

key: I don't have the privilege of eternity.
en: I don't have the privilege of eternity.
ja: あたしには、永遠というぜいたくは許されていないから。

key: I'm sure everyone else would like to do the same, and I'm not so special.
en: I'm sure everyone else would like to do the same, and I'm not so special.
ja: きっと誰もが同じことを望んでいるはずだし、あたしが特別なわけでもないわ。

key: I have to humble myself; accept my limitations, reign in my ambitions,
en: I have to humble myself; accept my limitations, reign in my ambitions,
ja: 自分を戒めて、限界を受け入れて、野心を抑え込まないといけない、

key: And breathe.
en: And breathe.
ja: そして、息をつくの。

key: I don't know how anyone does it.
en: I don't know how anyone does it.
ja: みんな一体どうやってこなしているのか、分からないわ。

key: Even now, I have another two meetings waiting for me.
en: Even now, I have another two meetings waiting for me.
ja: 今だって、あと二つも会議が待っているし。

key: I should be going.
en: I should be going.
ja: そろそろ行かなくちゃ。

key: Thank you for listening to me,
en: Thank you for listening to me,
ja: 話を聞いてくれてありがとう、

key: For your efforts, and for everything else.
en: For your efforts, and for everything else.
ja: あなたの尽力にも、他の全てにも、感謝しているわ。

key: I hope I see you again next time I blink.
en: I hope I see you again next time I blink.
ja: 次にまばたきをするときには、また会えるといいわね。

key: HARDY: So like I said, we've been coming here from time to time.
en: HARDY: So like I said, we've been coming here from time to time.
ja: ハーディ: だから言った通り、俺たち時々ここに来てるんだ。

key: Just the two of us, it's been nice.
en: Just the two of us, it's been nice.
ja: 二人だけでさ、なかなかいいもんだよ。

key: Took a bit of coaxing to get her to try goin' into the pools, but it turns out they're totally safe.
en: Took a bit of coaxing to get her to try goin' into the pools, but it turns out they're totally safe.
ja: あいつをこの水たまりに入らせるのに、ちょっと説得が要ったけど、実際完全に安全だって分かったんだ。

key: And then last time she was like,
en: And then last time she was like,
ja: それでこの前、あいつがこう言ってさ、

key: "I wonder what it would be like to dive down one of these waterfalls?"
en: "I wonder what it would be like to dive down one of these waterfalls?"
ja: 「この滝の一つに飛び込んだら、どんな感じなんだろうね?」って。

key: And I've been thinkin' about that ever since.
en: And I've been thinkin' about that ever since.
ja: それ以来、ずっとそのことを考えてるんだ。

key: At first I was thinkin', I got a couple Flying Types, nothin' a little swoop an' catch can't do for us.
en: At first I was thinkin', I got a couple Flying Types, nothin' a little swoop an' catch can't do for us.
ja: 最初は、ひこうタイプが何匹かいるし、さっと急降下してキャッチすりゃいいだろって思ってたんだけど。

key: But I dunno if I wanna take that risk.
en: But I dunno if I wanna take that risk.
ja: でも、そのリスクを取りたいかっていうと、分かんなくてさ。

key: Not with her.
en: Not with her.
ja: あいつが相手じゃ、なおさらな。

key: And you can't even see the bottom of these.
en: And you can't even see the bottom of these.
ja: それに、ここの底なんて全然見えないし。

key: If somethin' happened, I wouldn't be able to live with myself, yanno?
en: If somethin' happened, I wouldn't be able to live with myself, yanno?
ja: 何かあったら、俺自分を許せなくなると思うんだよな、分かるだろ?

key: So I've been tryna puzzle through a better case.
en: So I've been tryna puzzle through a better case.
ja: だから、もっといい方法をずっと考えてたんだ。

key: And I think I might be onto something.
en: And I think I might be onto something.
ja: で、何かつかめたかもしれない。

key: Hear me out--
en: Hear me out--
ja: 聞いてくれよ――

key: HARDY: Hoopa, right?
en: HARDY: Hoopa, right?
ja: ハーディ: フーパだよな?

key: HARDY: Over here, Sis!
en: HARDY: Over here, Sis!
ja: ハーディ: こっちだ、姉貴!

key: TITANIA: What the hell are you two doing?
en: TITANIA: What the hell are you two doing?
ja: ティタニア: あんたたち二人、一体何やってるのよ?

key: HARDY: We're workin' out how to jump offa this thing!
en: HARDY: We're workin' out how to jump offa this thing!
ja: ハーディ: ここから飛び降りる方法、考えてるとこ!

key: TITANIA: ...
en: TITANIA: ...
ja: ティタニア: ……

key: Get the hell over here.
en: Get the hell over here.
ja: こっちに来なさい、今すぐ。

key: HARDY: Aite, that sounded bad, I know--
en: HARDY: Aite, that sounded bad, I know--
ja: ハーディ: おっと、言い方悪かったよな、分かってる――

key: But I'm talkin' safety here.
en: But I'm talkin' safety here.
ja: でも、安全のための話なんだって。

key: I was just saying, if we can find a Hoopa, maybe he can make us some kinda portal through it so that we just go back into a pool!
en: I was just saying, if we can find a Hoopa, maybe he can make us some kinda portal through it so that we just go back into a pool!
ja: フーパを見つけられれば、ポータルか何か作ってもらって、水たまりに戻れるようにできるんじゃないかって話してただけなんだ!

key: TITANIA: I suppose that doesn't sound like your worst idea.
en: TITANIA: I suppose that doesn't sound like your worst idea.
ja: ティタニア: それは、あんたにしては最悪じゃない案かもね。

key: HARDY: Coming from you, that's a huge compliment!
en: HARDY: Coming from you, that's a huge compliment!
ja: ハーディ: 姉貴にそう言われたら、最高の褒め言葉だ!

key: TITANIA: Don't let it go to your head.
en: TITANIA: Don't let it go to your head.
ja: ティタニア: 調子に乗らないの。

key: Why did you call me here in the first place?
en: Why did you call me here in the first place?
ja: そもそも、なんであたしをここに呼んだのよ?

key: HARDY: Oh, right! Let's battle!
en: HARDY: Oh, right! Let's battle!
ja: ハーディ: あ、そうだった! バトルしようぜ!

key: You good to play ref', mate?
en: You good to play ref', mate?
ja: 審判やってくれるか?

key: TITANIA: You already scored a higher League rank than me.
en: TITANIA: You already scored a higher League rank than me.
ja: ティタニア: あんた、もうリーグ順位であたしより上なんでしょ。

key: How long is this little vendetta of yours going to last?
en: How long is this little vendetta of yours going to last?
ja: このちっちゃな意地の張り合い、いつまで続けるつもり?

key: HARDY: Nah, no vendetta-- I'm over all that.
en: HARDY: Nah, no vendetta-- I'm over all that.
ja: ハーディ: いや、意地とかじゃねえよ――そんなのはもう卒業したさ。

key: This is just for the sake of hanging out!
en: This is just for the sake of hanging out!
ja: ただ一緒に遊びたいだけなんだって!

key: 'Less there's somethin' else you'd rather do, but I figured this'd be the best call.
en: 'Less there's somethin' else you'd rather do, but I figured this'd be the best call.
ja: 他にやりたいことがあるなら別だけど、これが一番だと思ったんだよ。

key: Fine.
en: Fine.
ja: いいわよ。

key: But seriously, get over here-- both of you.
en: But seriously, get over here-- both of you.
ja: でも、マジでこっちに来なさい――二人とも。

key: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
en: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
ja: この　いわの　なかで　エネルギーが　かがやいている……

key: Do you want to mine the rock?
en: Do you want to mine the rock?
ja: いわを　さいくつしますか？

key: The energy from the rock's presence appears to linger in the air.
en: The energy from the rock's presence appears to linger in the air.
ja: あの岩が放つエネルギーが、空気中に漂っているようだ。

key: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
en: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
ja: 頑丈すぎて、壊すことも動かすこともできなさそうだ……

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
